about_the_game:
SPLASH-Paintball | DEMO delivers first impressions of a true paintball experience to PC: featuring licensed gear from renowned manufacturers, realistic ballistics, detailed tournament fields, and open scenario maps.

Choose from various game modes like Speedball, Capture the Flag, or the action-packed Arcade mode – play solo against bots or online with friends. With smooth controls and agile movements, every round feels like you're on a real field.

Regular free updates continually expand the game, inspired by feedback from the community. Be part of it from the start and contribute your ideas.

This and much more awaits you...

  • Licensed gear and equipment from renowned manufacturers

  • Real world tournament fields and scenario maps

  • Realistic ball and bunker physics

  • Realistic graphics down to the smallest detail

SPLASH-Paintball isn’t new to everyone – a growing player base is already active on other platforms.
